messages.subject: surveyReport not generating zip folder
parts:

CTtable = camtraps,
camOp = camOP,
speciesCol = "Species",
stationCol = "Station",
cameraCol = "Camera",
setupCol = "First.taken.date",
retrievalCol = "Last.taken.date",
CTDateFormat = "%Y-%m-%d",
recordDateTimeCol = "DateTimeOriginal",
recordDateTimeFormat = "%Y-%m-%d %H:%M:%S",
